{{Quote|When my cyborg soldiers are complete, the Jedi will crumble before us.|Bitt Panith|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Bitt Panith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] who assisted in the creation of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' robotic body. Similar to Grievous, Panith had multiple cybernetic parts installed to his arms, legs, and head. He had a secret laboratory on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Akoshissss]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he worked on [[Krossen|project Krossen]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] immune to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. An active scientist employed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Panith was funded directly by one of its leaders, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. When Dooku threatened to cut off Panith's funds because the project was taking much more time than anticipated, Panith became resentful of the Confederate leader. Krossen was destroyed, however, before it could be perfected or mass-produced by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]], [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|her Padawan]], [[Jaylen Kos]] and the [[Eighteenth Battalion]] during the [[Battle of Akoshissss]]. Panith was arrested by Eerin and was sent to trial on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the battle. He owned a [[Transport/Legends|transport]].

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Grievous-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous (pictured), whom Panith modified.]]
Panith was cowardly and paranoid, always keeping a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] around, even if he was alone. He was also very confident in his abilities and became resentful of those who did not believe in him as much as he did, as shown when Dooku threatened to cut his funding.

==Behind the scenes==
Bitt Panith was created for the [[2008]] [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi|''The Clone Wars: The Way of the Jedi'']] novel, a "Decide Your Destiny" young reader book based on [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' film]]. It was written by [[Jake Forbes]].
